verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents scoped or least-privilege API keys for agents. The only nearby items are user JWT delegation, a passing mention that the API explorer can run requests with API keys, and an MCP plugin that signs in via OAuth. None of these describe issuing credentials restricted to specific scopes or permissions, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
